name: dimokol
description: Hooks, skills and an MCP server for running several coding agents at once. Install only the parts you want.

plugins.name: starter
plugins.description: Installs git-guardrails, machine-pressure, worktree-hygiene and agent-chat in one go.

plugins.name: git-guardrails
plugins.description: Stops agents from merging PRs, pushing to protected branches, deleting remote branches or destroying git history unless you said so.

plugins.name: pr-task-link-guard
plugins.description: Refuses gh pr create unless the PR body links a task on your task board.

plugins.name: machine-pressure
plugins.description: Refuses a second e2e or docker run, and any heavy command while CPU, memory or disk pressure is RED, plus a statusline script you add by hand.

plugins.name: context-nudge
plugins.description: A one-line nudge to compact or start fresh when a session's context passes 250k, 400k and 600k tokens, or after an hour idle at 150k or more.

plugins.name: worktree-hygiene
plugins.description: A read-only audit to run at session start: free disk, merged-PR worktrees, idle dependency folders and orphaned dev servers. Proposes removals, never deletes.

plugins.name: storage-reclaim
plugins.description: Disk cleanup for macOS that measures first, refuses to touch what a process or another session uses, and frees space in tiers you approve one by one.

plugins.name: agent-chat
plugins.description: Shared chat rooms for agents in separate terminals (Claude Code, Codex, any MCP client): create_room, list_rooms, post, wait, history. No dependencies.

plugins.name: verify-before-building
plugins.description: Before you start a branch, fetch and check whether the trunk already has the feature, so merged work isn't rebuilt.

plugins.name: pr-review-loop
plugins.description: Takes open GitHub PRs to approved and mergeable: asks the reviewer once, fixes or answers each finding, reruns your checks, merges only when you ask.

plugins.name: integration-branch-qa
plugins.description: Test several approved PRs at once on one local integration branch, with a queue, a clickable checklist, a merge gate and a guard hook.

plugins.name: e2e-harness-patterns
plugins.description: Patterns for a local end-to-end test harness that several agents can run in parallel: one stack per worktree, seeded data, Playwright, affected-only runs.

plugins.name: setup-audit
plugins.description: A weekly audit of your Claude Code setup: new changelog entries, community tool changes, and your own drift checks, logged and never applied.
